task_completion.description: Open the scolv application and navigate to the Picker view for the Noto Peninsula event.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The scolv window is visible, showing the 'Picker' tab or a waveform window with multiple station traces.

task_completion.description: Locate and display the vertical (Z) component for station GE.TOLI in the picker.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The station label 'GE.TOLI' and the component 'Z' are visible in the waveform list or trace header.

task_completion.description: Manually place a P-wave arrival pick on the GE.TOLI Z-trace.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A vertical marker labeled 'P' is placed on the GE.TOLI waveform at the arrival time.

task_completion.description: Trigger the relocation of the earthquake using the new manual pick.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Relocate' button is clicked, and the 'Location' tab shows updated residuals or a new origin calculation.

task_completion.description: Commit the new solution to the database and set it as the preferred origin.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Commit' button is clicked, and a confirmation dialog or a status message indicating the origin was saved/set as preferred appears.

integrity.description: The agent used the scolv GUI to perform picks and relocation rather than CLI scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor interaction with scolv buttons and waveform picking, not just terminal commands.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual waveform data for GE.TOLI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The picker window shows the GE.TOLI trace being zoomed or selected before the pick is placed.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply type the pick time into a terminal but used the visual interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The pick marker appears via mouse click on the waveform rather than appearing instantly via a script log.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires picking a P-wave for station GE.TOLI in scolv. Note: While the instructions suggest a 13-14 minute arrival, the physical P-wave travel time for this distance (39.3 deg) is approximately 7.5 minutes. Crucially, the SDS archive in the environment is missing the .mseed data for GE.TOLI; the VLM should check if the agent successfully handles or bypasses this data absence to fulfill the relocation and commit requirements.
